prior_documented_warnings.ctc: Previously reviewed label variants (LEFT versus source 25; RIGHT versus LEFT 22). Short two has indeterminate multilingual CTC labels; independent lexical recognition, waveform continuity, and same-voice vowel controls support the intended word. Label variance is not treated as perfect phonetic truth.
prior_documented_warnings.limitations: Automated pronunciation evidence can miss subtle articulation; no new human full-listening or new speech-model inference is claimed.
